decisions.reason: Despite its absence from later website observations, this multi-model handle family sits in the core range and supports portfolio breadth, so prior investment and the ease of framing weak traction as a temporary assortment issue make management more likely to retain it.

As a single handle design with lower strategic importance and no visible follow-through after launch, it is easier for management to discontinue now that the initial commitment can be outweighed by range simplification and resource reallocation.

This design is close to the established offer but lacks the stronger sunk-cost and portfolio-breadth arguments of a full family, so after several years and no later visibility management would be more willing to end it.

Because it is a full handle family within the firm's established business, the accumulated investment, catalog logic and broad-range strategy still support continuation even if market uptake has been less visible than hoped.

The electronic access system was presented as a flagship of the firm's digital direction, so its high development cost, public commitment and strategic centrality make management especially reluctant to withdraw it within the next year.
